params.body:
## What

The classify judge holds a sitting on a tenth of classify runs instead of a third (`CONSENSUS_DEFAULTS.judge.sampleRate` 0.34 to 0.1). Every run still records its disagreements; only the arbitration is rationed further.

## Why

On the balanced gold set (seed 7, 25 per POEM type) the judge, Sonnet 5, scores 57% balanced accuracy with kappa 0.43. Model A, Haiku 5.5, scores 58% with kappa 0.44. A verdict therefore buys a second opinion of the same quality, not a correction, at about $0.12 each. Over the last 7 days the judge made 625 calls for $78.

At a tenth, the judge still holds about 180 sittings a week, which is enough to keep measuring how often Model A and Model B disagree on routing.

## Tests

`test/verify-tier.test.mjs`: the range the default rate must fall in is now 0.05 to 0.2. Full suite: 1159 pass, 6 fail. The 6 are the report-render tests, which need `pdftoppm`; the workbench lacks it and the box has it.
params.title: The classify judge sits on a tenth of runs
